context: Sho asks Grandma about being sick.
purpose: Casual home register; vocabulary (電気/病気/ひとり/普段/両親) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、病気って怖い?
lines.style: curious small child voice, bright warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 普段から元気でいれば、怖くないわ。
lines.en: If you stay healthy daily, it's not scary.
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm gentle delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ひとりで寝るの、ちょっと怖いな。
lines.en: Sleeping alone is a little scary.
lines.style: timid small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 電気を少しつけておけば、安心よ。
lines.en: Leave a light on a little and you'll be at ease.
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 両親が、いない時もあるもん。
lines.style: pouty small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ご両親は、すぐ戻ってくるわよ。
lines.en: Your parents will be back soon.
lines.style: gentle grandmother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 普段は、ひとりでも平気だよ!
lines.en: Usually I'm fine on my own!
lines.style: proud small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: えらいわ。電気は寝る前に消してね。
lines.en: Good boy. Turn off the light before bed.
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
